meaning: To leave someone or something and not come back.
pidgin: To comot leave am, no look back.
example: He abandoned his car on the express road when it broke down.

meaning: An opinion you give someone about what they should do.
pidgin: Word wey you give person to guide am.
example: My mama's advice was to finish NYSC before I travel.

meaning: Something that belongs to a different time period, out of place in the present.
pidgin: Old school tin wey time don pass.
example: Still asking clients to send payment proof by fax? That's anachronistic, abeg.
tip: It sounds formal. In casual Naija talk, people say "old school" or "outdated."

meaning: Feeling strong annoyance or upset.
pidgin: When vex dey catch person.
example: Oga was angry because NEPA took light during the match.

meaning: To collect something from someone, promising to return it.
pidgin: To collect wetin no be your own, say you go return am.
example: Abeg, make I borrow your charger, I go return am before you close.

meaning: Ready to face danger or difficulty without fear.
pidgin: Person wey get mind, no dey fear.
example: She was brave enough to report the fake agent.

meaning: A system with many rules, layers of approval, and paperwork, often making things slow.
pidgin: Na file go, file come.
example: I just wanted to change one letter in my name, but the bureaucracy at that office had me running from desk to desk for two weeks.
tip: Often used to complain about delays. Related: bureaucrat, bureaucratic.

meaning: Having a lot to do; not free.
pidgin: Hand full, no time at all.
example: Wuse market is always busy on Saturdays.

meaning: Low in price; doesn't cost much money.
pidgin: E no cost, e dey go for small money.
example: Tomatoes are cheap in the market during the rainy season.

meaning: To say you are unhappy about something.
pidgin: To dey talk say tins no dey okay.
example: Passengers complained when the driver increased transport fare.

meaning: To make someone unsure or unable to understand.
pidgin: To scatter person head.
example: The new BRT routes confused many commuters.

meaning: To make something happen later than planned.
pidgin: To make tin late, no come on time.
example: Traffic in Nyanya delayed me for over an hour.

meaning: To fail to do what someone hoped or expected.
pidgin: To fall person hand.
example: The tailor disappointed me; my cloth no ready for the wedding.

meaning: Very ready and excited to do something.
pidgin: When person dey hungry to do tin.
example: The corps members were eager to collect their first allowee.

meaning: Unusual or a bit strange in behaviour, style, or ideas, usually in a harmless or interesting way.
pidgin: He get him own style.
example: Our new landlord is eccentric. He wears agbada to jog every morning.
tip: Milder than "strange" or "weird," so it's safe to use politely.

meaning: To get pleasure from something.
pidgin: To dey feel am well well.
example: We enjoyed the jollof at the owambe.

meaning: Not real or genuine; made to deceive.
pidgin: No be original, na 'Aba made' copy.
example: He sold her a fake iPhone at Computer Village.

meaning: Easy to break or damage.
pidgin: Tin wey fit break anyhow.
example: Handle that crate of eggs gently, it's fragile.

meaning: Happy to give money, time or help to others.
pidgin: Person wey hand dey open, e dey dash.
example: Our pastor is so generous, he paid school fees for three children.

meaning: To talk about other people's private lives.
pidgin: To dey yarn people business, amebo.
example: The women at the compound love to gossip after church.

meaning: Not proud; not thinking you are better than others.
pidgin: Person wey no dey form big man.
example: Even after he hammed, he remained humble.

meaning: To work hard, often doing several jobs, to make money.
pidgin: To dey run up and down find money.
example: Na hustle dey make am do tailoring and sell provisions together.

meaning: To say or do something rude that hurts someone's feelings.
pidgin: To yab person, talk rubbish give am.
example: The conductor insulted the passenger over a ₦100 change.

meaning: Unhappy because someone has something you want.
pidgin: When person eye dey red for your progress.
example: He became jealous when his friend bought a new phone.

meaning: Friendly and caring towards others.
pidgin: Person wey get good heart.
example: A kind woman paid my okada fare when my transfer failed.

meaning: Not willing to work or make effort.
pidgin: Person wey body no dey do am for work.
example: Don't be lazy, go and fetch the water.

meaning: To say something you know is not true.
pidgin: To dey talk wetin no happen, to fabu.
example: He lied that he was in traffic, but he was still sleeping.

meaning: Something done wrongly by accident.
pidgin: Wetin you do wrong, no be say you plan am.
example: I sent the money to the wrong account by mistake.

meaning: To discuss to reach an agreement, often on price.
pidgin: To price am, beat down the money.
example: You have to negotiate before you buy anything in the market.

meaning: The belief that life has no real meaning, purpose, or values.
pidgin: Life no get meaning.
example: After three failed businesses, his talk is pure nihilism: "Nothing matters, na just survival."
tip: Philosophical and formal. Related: nihilist, nihilistic.

meaning: Able to wait calmly without getting upset.
pidgin: Person wey fit wait, no dey rush.
example: Be patient, the bank queue go soon move.

meaning: Feeling pleased about something you or others did; or thinking too highly of yourself.
pidgin: Chest wey dey high, sometimes na shakara.
example: His parents were proud when he graduated with a second class upper.

meaning: Not willing to spend or share money.
pidgin: Person wey hand tight, no dey gree drop.
example: He's too stingy to even buy pure water for his friends.

meaning: Found everywhere, all the time.
pidgin: E full everywhere.
example: Keke is ubiquitous in Abuja suburbs. You can't walk two minutes without seeing one.
tip: Formal, so it fits writing or presentations.

meaning: To turn something upside down, or completely disrupt how things normally work.
pidgin: E scatter everything.
example: The new fuel price upends everybody's budget. Even transport fare don double.
tip: Common in news and business talk.

meaning: To use something carelessly or without good purpose.
pidgin: To throw tin away anyhow, spoil am for nothing.
example: Stop wasting data on videos, your subscription go soon finish.
